title: From Inbox to Invoice: Document Intelligence Brings More Automation to Payables
summary: We’re expanding Document Intelligence in Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT, giving finance teams automation that removes repetitive work without removing their control.
body_markdown:
*By David Farah, VP and General Manager of Financial Products at Blackbaud*


Finance teams at social impact organizations keep their missions moving, but too many are doing it from a shared inbox, a growing stack of invoices, and through hours of hard work and manual entry. Every manual handoff costs time and creates one more chance for information to get missed or entered inconsistently.


That’s why we’re expanding Document Intelligence in Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT, giving finance teams automation that removes repetitive work without removing their control. Document Intelligence for Payables is now available through an early adopter program, complete with a new Inbox Automation capability. Together, they create a connected workflow from the moment an invoice arrives until an invoice record is ready for review.


*Inbox Automation helps finance teams streamline invoice intake by identifying and routing invoice documents directly into the payables workflow.*


####


#### Turning Invoice Documents into Ready-to-Review Records


Document Intelligence uses Blackbaud AI to extract key information from invoices, including vendor names, amounts, dates and line items. It uses that information to populate an invoice record in Financial Edge NXT, allowing the finance team to confirm the details before moving forward.


This practical assistance is embedded directly into the financial management system customers already use. Finance teams gain a faster path from document to record without adding a separate tool or disconnected process, and every invoice remains subject to human review before it is approved or paid.


*Document Intelligence extracts key invoice details such as vendor names, amounts, dates and line items, reducing manual data entry. Extracted invoice details are used to create a draft record for review within Financial Edge NXT, helping teams process invoices more efficiently.*


####


#### Extending Automation to the Inbox


For many organizations, invoice processing begins in email. Staff must monitor a shared inbox, identify invoice attachments and move those documents into the appropriate system before review can begin.


Inbox Automation handles that front end by moving invoice documents from email into Document Intelligence for processing. Connecting intake with AI-assisted data extraction reduces sorting and repetitive work while preserving visibility into each invoice.


The result is a more connected experience from invoice receipt to review, with finance teams remaining in control before an invoice is approved or paid.


#### What This Means for Finance Teams


With Document Intelligence for Payables and Inbox Automation, organizations can:


- Capture invoice documents arriving through email.


- Extract key invoice information using Blackbaud AI.


- Populate invoice records in Financial Edge NXT for review.


- Keep finance teams in control of every invoice before it is approved or paid.


- Manage more of the payables process within Financial Edge NXT instead of moving between disconnected systems.


By connecting invoice intake, document processing and human review inside Financial Edge NXT, we’re giving customers a more efficient way to manage payables while maintaining the oversight essential to responsible financial stewardship.


#### Part of a Broader Vision for Intelligent Financial Management


Document Intelligence is one part of Blackbaud’s broader work to equip social impact organizations with practical, responsible AI embedded in their daily workflows. Across Financial Edge NXT, we’re focusing intelligent assistance on the administrative work that can pull finance professionals away from analysis, stewardship and other mission-critical responsibilities.


The early adopter program gives participating customers an opportunity to use Document Intelligence for Payables and provide feedback as the experience continues to develop. That collaboration reflects how we build: start with a real customer workflow, keep people in control and apply intelligent technology where it can make essential work simpler and more connected.
